progressiveHints.text: Choose one situation where you would naturally use い-adjective + ければ / N・な-adjective + なら / Vたら; do not write the whole sentence yet.
Build the sentence in parts: choose the content first, then check the form that carries respond to preferences, topics, and situations with an appropriate condition.
Compare your form, meaning, and neutral planning with the worked model. Change the content so the response is your own.

retryFeedback.diagnostic: Check the form and meaning again. A common mix-up is this: ければ attaches to an i-adjective, なら frames a topic or noun, and たら frames an event
retryFeedback.retryPrompt: Revise one part at a time, then try again with your own content.
